entries.reason: the setting is thread-local, as the header says, so it is kept in thread-local storage and a thread that has set none answers the model a thread starts with
entries.effect: 0 for a model the library has, -1 for one it has not, and the setting is then left as it was; the model is per thread and a thread that has set none is BLAS_THREADING_MULTI_THREADED
entries.source: the host's own Accelerate, measured for the default a thread starts with, for a set and for a refused value; the 18.0 cache, which names both functions where no earlier cache the port holds does; the enumeration and the two prototypes of the host's vecLib/thread_api.h, read from that header and not from the build SDK, which has no such header
